fact_text: Waggles Foods began in 2020 as a home-kitchen pet food venture, and the founder said its products contain no artificial flavours, colours or grains.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles Foods opened its own factory in 2022, after first sending its stock to an outside vendor for canning, with labelling and delivery done in-house.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles Foods started trading in January 2020, and COVID-19 lockdowns in March 2020 pushed it to sell through its own website and Foodpanda.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles ran a free-sample campaign in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad, which the founder said drew a positive response and led buyers to reorder.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: In 2020 an imported dog food sold for PKR 220 against PKR 200 for Waggles' own product, according to the founder.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: The founder said an imported dog food was priced at PKR 1,000 against PKR 500 for Waggles' own product, so Waggles sells at about half the imported price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: The founder said Waggles keeps prices low on purpose to be a brand that serves Pakistan's consumers, and that the price gap is also a clear advantage for buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles said its products reach around 1,000 stores across Pakistan through modern trade chains such as Imtiaz and Al-Fatah, plus online delivery.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: The founder put Pakistan's annual pet food imports at about USD 300 to 400 million, with origins including China and Thailand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles sells 10 pet food SKUs: six dog food products and four cat food products across two parallel cat food lines, one with vegetables and one pure protein.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles buys chicken in 5 kg and 10 kg bags from large Lahore poultry suppliers, ships it by refrigerated truck to Karachi, and stores it in its own cold storage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles sources sweet potatoes, carrots, potatoes and pumpkin from the local market and cleans and processes them in its own factory.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles uses Chinese-made cans, and the canned food gets a two-year shelf life from the canning process itself, according to the founder.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles has about 40 to 45 staff in total, of whom 25 work in the factory across day and night shifts and 10 to 15 in management, finance, accounts and marketing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles said it is speaking to distributors in Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and the UAE, and plans to start exports by the end of 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles makes halal canned food under private labels for other brands, and has helped Pakistani brands clear the US FDA process for stock exported to the USA.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles said it holds ISO, HACCP and GMP certifications, and that completing them let it run pet food and halal food as two separate operations in one facility.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles offers contract canning to small restaurants, and its plan given to them is to raise output from about 300 cans a day to 3,000 cans a day.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles grew tomatoes on about 7 to 8 acres of its own farm and processes the harvest into paste and puree for canning; the video called this the second harvest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Waggles has packed food for major Pakistani brands including Lal Qila and Karachi Haleem, and has canned tomato paste and onion gravy for Karachi Delights.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: The founder said Waggles' plan rests on a high-quality, grain-free product at a price near half the imported brands, which he said gives consumers a clear comparison.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Triton Engineering, a second business linked to the founder's group, started in January 2023 as an elevator and vertical transport firm.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Triton holds the Pakistan distribution rights for LG elevators, a brand the founder said it chose after two visits to the Canton Fair in China.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Triton lists new elevator installations in Scheme 33 and a Gulmohar City project, and says it has a tie-up with Al Raouf Group.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Triton holds maintenance operations for Ocean Mall, Newplex and Atrium Mall, which the founder described as among Karachi's major malls.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: Triton's maintenance work in Karachi covers about 100 elevators, according to the founder.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)

fact_text: The founder compared the combined population of Karachi and Hyderabad with that of Canada, and argued that Pakistan's market is large enough for small businesses to scale.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Waggles Foods Built a Pet Food Brand for Pakistan and Middle East | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-13)
